method: First 15 rows of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in file order: row 1 is cve-pairs-python, rows 2-15 are cve-pairs-php; the file held 104 missed cases (1 Python, 103 PHP, no JavaScript). For each case I read the fix commit's message and per-file diff (gh api repos/O/R/commits/SHA) and, where the diff did not show the vulnerable side, the changed files at the fix commit's parent (gh api contents?ref=SHA^): bulk_import.py; errors/processor.php, errors/default/page.phtml and report.phtml; module/frontend/add.php; usersearch.php; app/View/Templates/upload_file.ctp and app/Controller/TemplatesController.php; index.php; phpmyfaq/admin/index.php and header.php; app/messages/messages_thread.php; ImageController.php and routes/web.php; admin/user_list_backend.php; www/admin/campaign-zone-zones.php; main/calendar/agenda_list.php and main/inc/lib/agenda.lib.php; ajaxIndex.ctp; Pay2PayPayment.php; includes/html/forms/customoid.inc.php. All API calls were one at a time with 2 s between. Nothing was skipped: 15 of 15 noted, all with source and sink visible in the fix's parent. 89 rows remain unread in misses.tsv (all cve-pairs-php).

notes.source: cmk/gui/wato/pages/bulk_import.py:130-133 (fix parent): _file_path() calls request.get_unicode_input_mandatory("file_id", "%s-%d" % (user.id, int(time.time()))) - the file id is a request variable read through Checkmk's own wrapper, not request.args/form
notes.sink: same file, :133 return self._upload_tmp_path / ("%s.csv" % file_id), then :148 store.save_text_to_file(self._file_path(), ...), :170 csv_file = self._file_path().open(...) and :267 self._file_path().unlink() - the value is joined to the temp directory and the result is written, opened and deleted
notes.between: page() (:321-325) branches on request.has_var("file_id"); the read side opens and parses the CSV, the write side saves the upload, the delete side unlinks it. No normalisation or containment check exists before the join; the fix makes file_id alphanumeric and generates a uuid for uploads, which rejects ../ on both the read and write paths. Second explanation: sink (Path.__truediv__ / .open() / save_text_to_file is not one of the calls a path rule knows).
notes.fix: requires file_id.isalnum() (MKUserError otherwise) and sets the upload's file_id to uuid.uuid4().hex

<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/uploads/images/{path}', function (string $path) {
